newsitem.title: USA: Independent files for 300,000 common shares.
newsitem.headline: Independent files for 300,000 common shares.

text.p: Independent Bankshares Inc filed Tuesday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to 300,000 common shares.
The Abilene, Tex.,-based bankholding company said net proceeds estimated at $3.0 million will be used to fund a portion of the cost to acquire Crown Park Bankshares Inc.
Crown Park is a bank holding company that owns Western National Bank, of Lubbock, Tex., according to the filing.
The offering will be made through underwriters Hoffer & Arnett. The underwriters have an over-allotment option for up to 45,000 additinoal shares.
The offering includes 30,000 shares being reserved for sale to Independent Bankshares' directors, executive officers and affiliates, the filing said.
